description: This file defines extension methods for MemoryPool<byte> to compute minimum segment and allocation sizes.

classes.name: MemoryPoolExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for MemoryPool<byte> to determine minimum segment and allocation sizes.

methods.name: GetMinimumSegmentSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum segment size based on the pool's MaxBufferSize or a default value if pool is null.

methods.name: GetMinimumAllocSize
methods.description: Returns half of the minimum segment size as the minimum allocation size.
